main_claim: A Yahoo/Uncrowned podcast episode listing says the hosts react to Ilia Topuria being 'ready to fight' among several other MMA and boxing topics.
note: The saved text is a video description ('The Boys in the Back react to Ilia Topuria being "ready to fight," UFC fighters speaking at the ... Convention, the RIZIN x PFL title fight, and more') plus unrelated clip blurbs; he is one topic in a list, so only_mentioned (one_of_several possible as the lead item). Nobody in the text makes a plain statement about him and the 'ready to fight' line names no speaker, so act none_of_these (the hosts' reaction would be assesses_him) and no_fact; an editor could read the quoted 'ready to fight' as status_update at firmness reported.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko and Punahele Soriano both made weight at 77.11 kg ahead of their UFC Fight Night 287 bout in Paris on 5 September.
note: 'Данило Донченко (14-2) та американець Пунахеле Соріано (13-4) успішно пройшли офіційне зважування ... 77,11 кг', then card times; the booking is restated as the weigh-in's premise and the June win over Berggren is background, so next fight and result are no. Soriano gets only his record and weight while the piece is written around the Ukrainian ('Для Донченка це вже третій виступ'), so main_subject, though a weigh-in of both men could be read as one_of_several. His wish to fight in Paris is described, not quoted.

main_claim: Michael 'Venom' Page won another dull decision at UFC Paris days after promising to take risks.
note: Topuria appears only in an inserted link line ('LATEST NEWS: Jon Anik hints at internal conversations about Justin Gaethje vs Ilia Topuria 2'), which is page furniture, not the article's text. Source and act answer for the main content (Page speaking about his own performance): nobody does anything regarding Topuria, so act none_of_these.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says Ilia Topuria is doing well, enjoying life and will come back to reclaim his belt.
note: The article frames Merab's words as information 'sobre su recuperación y estado de salud': 'Está bien. Es muy positivo. Está disfrutando de la vida', so health reported by a named friend, though 'he is fine' is brief enough that status_update or no_fact (with act assesses_him for 'volverá y recuperará lo que es suyo') is arguable. Merab is a fellow UFC fighter and friend, not an opponent. His post-fight statement ('Me recuperaré. Descansaré. Y volveré más fuerte') is quoted at length under 'Las palabras de Topuria' but recalled from after the fight, so he_speaks yes is uncertain; Gaethje's 'no habrá revancha' is a closing section about a wish, not a booked or rumoured fight.

main_claim: Eddie Alvarez says a Gaethje–Topuria rematch would be a mistake and Topuria should rebuild against a lesser opponent first.
note: Alvarez, a former UFC champion and therefore a fighter: 'I think he needs to take on a lesser opponent, build that confidence again' is sincere advice (steers_him), though much of the quote assesses his state ('His brain's still gonna suffer a form of PTSD'), so assesses_him is possible. 'Growing momentum' and 'those rumors' about a rematch name no source, date or event, so no fact and next fight no.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev says he does not consider Yaroslav Amosov a dangerous opponent for him.
note: 'Ні, я не думаю, що він небезпечний суперник ... Я взагалі не вважаю для себе його небезпечним' is an assessment of Amosov's level; no fight between them is booked or reported, so Makhachev is other_fighter_side. Amosov's May win over Alvarez is recalled as background.

main_claim: Jorge Masvidal says Yaroslav Amosov is a nightmare matchup for Islam Makhachev and could beat him.
note: Masvidal, an ex-UFC fighter: 'Амосов — це кошмар для Махачева. Він більший, вищий і, ймовірно, сильніший' assesses his attributes and chances; since no fight exists, predicts_his_fight is a possible alternative reading of 'зможе його перевершити'.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko's next fight is set for 5 September at UFC Fight Night in Paris against Punahele Soriano.
note: 'Наступний поєдинок ... відбудеться 5 вересня на турнірі UFC Fight Night, який прийматиме Париж. Суперником українця стане ... Пунахеле Соріано' is stated as fact with nobody quoted; an embedded Instagram post of his ('Допис, поширений Daniil DonchenKO') suggests his own announcement, so official_or_done, but the text names no announcer, so reported is possible. The post is only embedded, not quoted, so he_speaks no.

His wish to fight Rodriguez ('заявив про бажання побитися з Даніелем Родрігесом') is a callout described, not quoted, and his speaking French is mentioned without quoting him, so next fight no and he_speaks no.

Pick: Soriano'), a fresh assessment and pick of his fight shared with the rest of the card, so one_of_several; only_mentioned is arguable since the new content is only the writer's opinion. The booking is the premise of the pick, so no fact.

main_claim: Justin Gaethje, in an interview, talks about life after the White House fight, his golf, his injured hands and whether he will keep fighting.
note: Topuria is named only in the intro recap ('his unforgettable title-winning performance against Ilia Topuria at the White House and making the previously unbeaten champion quit on the stool'); the transcript never returns to him. Gaethje fought him, so opponent_side, but he talks about himself and makes no statement about Topuria, so act none_of_these; the result is background to an interview, so result no.

Donchenko is a -238 favorite'), ending 'I'm taking him to win this contest at +100 by KO/TKO/DQ or submission', so one_of_several per the guide's preview rule, though the piece leans on Donchenko enough for main_subject. The booking and the June Berggren win are the premise of the pick, so no fact and next fight no.
